footnotes: From pre-tax income to net loss to Resolute Holdings Management: after $140M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 9.9% to $462M in 2025. Gross margin was 56.3%, versus 52.1% a year earlier, and operating income rose 13.2% to $143M, a 31.0% margin.
The net loss widened to $5.9M, or −$0.69 per share, from $2.3M. Operating cash flow was $196M and free cash flow $189M, versus $145M; Resolute Holdings Management returned $4.1M through buybacks.
watch: Cost of revenue is 44% of revenue.
